description: 경기도_주요 도로별 소통 정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 경기도 주요 도로별 소통 정보는 경기도교통정보센터에서 제공하는 API 기반의 실시간 도로 소통 정보 데이터로, 도로명, 도로방향, 구간속도, 교통량, 지체시간 등 교통 흐름 관련 정보를. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 교통소통, 구간속도, 교통량, 지체시간, 교통정보센터. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
